limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter rollover but also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` on input acceptance, whereas the reference keeps `ready_a` low until the first post-reset clock edge and asserts `valid_b` whenever the pre-edge count is 5, even during a gap.

The testbench hard-coded `ready_a` high during reset and expected `valid_b` only on the sixth accepted bit, so its reset and gap tests endorsed the rewrite instead of catching the reference mismatches.
